profiles.name: Peugeot, Citroën (Raise PSA, original screen kept)
profiles.description: Raise (RZC) box for PSA keeping the original small screen (RePsaProtocol_KeepOriginalDisplay). Car Info's decoder (com.can.activity 1.0.3991) for these boxes; cars and car types (0xA7) from its managers and buildCarTypePacket. FD framing, 19200 bit/s, no acknowledgement; car type 0xA7 [05, trim, 00] every second. Not tried on a car yet.
